    • nextCharToBoolean

      public static boolean nextCharToBoolean(String prompt, char condition1, char condition2)
      It takes a user input, and if it matches condition1, it returns true. If it matches condition2, it returns false. Else, if keeps the user in a loop.
      Parameters:
      prompt - question to ask user
      condition1 - what user-input must match for true
      condition2 - what user-input must match for(@code false)
      Returns:
      true for when user-input matches condition1, false for when user-input matches condition2
      See Also:
      • nextInt(int)
      • nextInt(String, String, int, int)
      • nextline()
      • else it just goes in a loop until the user gives a valid input

    • nextInt

      public static int nextInt(int moreT)
      Gets a user-input. If its not a digit(which is tested with isDigit(String)), it makes the user try again. If its less than than the parameter, it also makes the user try again.
      Parameters:
      moreT - the lowest allowed
      Returns:
      -1 for no input, else the user-input parsed as an int for a valid input
      See Also:
      • nextCharToBoolean(String, char, char)
      • nextInt(String, String, int, int)
